title: Ride The skies
description: A defying gravity datapack to fly through the sky on various mount.
body:
# Ride the skies Datapack
**Current ongoing version - MC 1.21.7**

This Datapack will allow you to fly through the sky


### How it work
To be able to fly, You have to craft the item (cf craft)
Once done, you just have to right click on it to activate it, to get out of it you just have to shift.
